shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical monolithic face
justification: A shows a distinctly figural low relief on an upright pillar — an anthropomorphic/zoomorphic torso with a belt-like band, an arm bent over the front, hanging vertical elements and a projecting knobbed boss — while B shows a tall slab face bearing only faint horizontal rows of small linear marks with no discernible figure. The only real correspondence is the generic format of relief-worked upright stone faces, with no shared motif, posture or arrangement of depicted elements.
